needTwoPanels: A mosaic needs at least two panels.
spreadAcrossSky: The panels are spread across the whole sky: they do not form a mosaic.
invalidReferenceSolution: The astrometric solution of the reference panel is not valid.
panelTooFar: A panel is too far from the others to fit in the same mosaic.
tooLarge: The mosaic would measure {width} × {height} pixels: too large. Check that the selected panels are really close to each other.
panelSizeMismatch: Panel {panel} does not have the size given by its astrometric solution.

progress.matching: Matching background and brightness between panels
